description: Every existing automated test mapped to the behaviour it protects and the journey that owns it. The new stack needs one test per behaviour, not one per file.

behaviours.behaviour: Every panel/public URL renders 200 and shows its own headline/marker text
Panel pages carry sidebar, topbar, .main-scroll and mark the current nav item aria-current=page
Detail routes keep their index section active in the sidebar
/en/... renders English navigation and page title
Unknown customer id -> 404
Unknown settings tab -> 404
Unsupported locale prefix -> 404
POST /preferences/theme persists and the next document renders data-theme accordingly
Unknown theme value falls back to light
POST /preferences/sidebar persists and the shell renders data-sidebar accordingly
Valid e-mail sign-in redirects to dashboard and shows the e-mail in the sidebar footer
Empty e-mail is rejected with 'Podaj adres e-mail.'
Malformed e-mail is rejected with 'poprawny adres e-mail'
Logout redirects to login and restores the default identity
Event without idempotency_id is rejected
Unknown event type is rejected
Accepted event is published once on /accounts/1/events as a rendered event-row with translated type and detail
Same idempotency id is never published twice
POST /collect answers 202, then 200 on replay, 400 on invalid payload
Application cache round-trips through Postgres
behaviours.note: infrastructure behaviour; the new stack proves its Postgres-backed state store the same way

behaviours.behaviour: Sidebar entries navigate; only .main-scroll scrolls; sidebar/theme survive reload; locale switch keeps page; breadcrumb
Landing PL/EN structure, demo button, sign-in shows identity, browser blocks malformed e-mail
Four KPIs, cardiogram canvas redraws on theme change, 10 live rows with topic attribute, links to customer/automation, pause toggles data-paused
30 rows, 9 type + 4 site + 4 range filters, collected event arrives as .event-row.new over SSE, replay not shown twice
24 rows, 7 columns, pagination 'Strona 1 z 192', row opens profile, profile facts/scores/timeline/tabs, back link
6 cards, editor list (3 steps) and flow (6 nodes, 5 edges) views, simulation card, publish button
Campaign KPIs, 4 filters, 5 rows
Email editor library/envelope/document/inspector; document stays white in dark theme

behaviours.test: tests/e2e/specs/lists.spec.ts widgets (2 tests) + editors.spec.ts popup editor (4 tests)
behaviours.behaviour: Widget list with preview, preview switch by ?preview=, editor type/device switches, inspector triggers/audience/position grid
4 sources, 4 feeds, one failing with HTTP 503, matching diagnostic with 142 mismatched
Four wizard steps with their content, stepper forward/back, upload advances to step 2 and shows the file name
8 tabs at own URLs with markers, highlighted tracker snippet, DNS states, failing webhook, notification matrix 8x3 with 15 checked
Hourly heartbeat message handled by the worker logs 'Scheduler heartbeat tick.'; missed runs execute once after restart
